# UVATIME

> UVATIME is a digital agency specializing in Shopify development and Shopify CRO (conversion rate optimization) audits. Offices in Brasov, Brasov, Romania and Jackson, Wyoming, USA.

UVATIME helps e-commerce brands build high-performing Shopify stores and fix conversion leaks on homepage, collection, product page, and cart — with annotated Figma layouts developers can ship from.

## Services

- [Shopify CRO Audit](https://uvatime.com/shopify-cro-audit/): 3-business-day conversion audit of homepage, collection, product page and cart (desktop + mobile). Deliverables: annotated before/after Figma layouts, expected-effect notes, priority list (before Black Friday vs after), walkthrough call. Early bird 199 EUR until 9 November 2026, then 350 EUR. No Shopify admin access required — live store URL is enough. Implementation quoted separately.
- [Shopify Development Offers](https://uvatime.com/shopify-offers/): Full Shopify store packages — Fastrack 2600 EUR, Enhanced 3600 EUR, Bespoke 6600 EUR.
- Software development and mobile (React Native / PWA) — see homepage.
